# FreshContext

> Checks whether a company's support bot answers still match the live sources they came from.

Canonical: https://freshcontext.dev/
Free Help-centre Snapshot: https://freshcontext.dev/snapshot
How the audit works: https://freshcontext.dev/how-it-works
Pricing: https://freshcontext.dev/pricing
Contact: https://freshcontext.dev/contact
Legacy open-source package: https://freshcontext.dev/legacy
Specification (legacy): https://freshcontext.dev/spec

FreshContext sells the Stale Answer Audit: a fixed-price service that checks up to 200 (or 500) of a support bot's real answers against the live pages they rely on (prices, versions, dates, plan names, links). Each finding is checked by a person and carries the source passage and the time it was read. A claim the source cannot settle is reported as unclear, never as current. Monitoring re-checks the same sources monthly after an audit.

The free Help-centre Snapshot reads a company's public help centre (at most 150 pages, obeying robots.txt) and reports up to 10 person-checked issues such as broken links, retired pages and plain contradictions.

FreshContext does not certify accuracy or compliance, and is not legal advice. The earlier open-source package, freshcontext-mcp, is MIT-licensed and frozen.
